# Official Sleep 2.1 serialization vectors

The `.ser` files in this directory are generated by
[`../generate_phase1.sl`](../generate_phase1.sl) and
[`../generate_closure_phases.sl`](../generate_closure_phases.sl) using the
official Sleep 2.1 JAR from <https://sleep.dashnine.org/download/sleep.jar>.

- JAR SHA-256: `0ddde5e9e8d8d8d334d071b1f887c379f5d0be9b190566f05365997b3e375ff1`
- Sleep version: `2.1 (20090430)`
- JAR manifest: `Created-By: 1.7.0_75-b13`, class-file version 48
- Generator verification runtime: Homebrew OpenJDK `26.0.2.1` on macOS ARM64

The JAR is not redistributed. The checked-in vectors are small test facts used
to verify both Java-producer/Go-consumer and Go-producer/Java-consumer
interoperability against OPFOR's named `sleep-2.1-official` profile.

## Opt-in official-JAR consumer check

Ordinary CI remains pure Go. With the official JAR downloaded separately, the
reverse OPFOR-producer to Java-consumer check is reproducible with:

```sh
OPFOR_SLEEP_JAR=/tmp/opfor-sleep21.jar \
OPFOR_JAVA=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin/java \
go test ./internal/opfor -run TestOfficialSleepJavaConsumesOPFORPhaseOneStreams -count=1 -v
```

`OPFOR_JAVA` is optional when `java` is already on `PATH`. The test verifies
the JAR SHA-256 before running [`../consume_phase1.sl`](../consume_phase1.sl).
Its expected consumer output is:

```text
hello
42
@('x', 7)
apple,2,3.5
%(third => 3, first => 1, second => 2)
class java.lang.String:raw
class java.lang.Integer:17
class java.lang.Long:4294967296
class java.lang.Double:6.5
class java.lang.Class:class java.lang.String
```
